specific_learning_outcomes: a) Summarize information from audio texts to confirm understanding
b) Break down information to comprehend main ideas from audio texts
c) Appreciate improvement on language proficiency through listening
learning_activities: Listen to an audio text and distinguish sounds /ʒ/ as in jeune, jour, jupe and /ʃ/ as in chat
Use information from an audio text to identify physical attributes of a person (grand, petite, gros, belle...)
Play flashcard games collaboratively to internalize acquired vocabulary (s'appeler, parler, avoir, habiter, être...)
Answer guided questions from an audio text on introduction of friends, their birthdays, likes and their dislikes
Research and make notes from recorded passages on hobbies and interests of friends (Mon amie aime....Elle déteste....)
Respond appropriately to aural questions from downloaded items on likes and dislikes of different characters
Write short texts showing physical attributes of different characters as portrayed from audio items
key_inquiry_questions: Why should you have good listening skills?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Creativity and imagination: This is developed as the learner undertakes tasks on using information from aural texts that keep them working on a problem, adjusts and rethink their ideas until they find solutions.
competency_mappings.values: Unity: This is enhanced as the learner displays team spirit as they collaborate with peers in card games to internalize acquired vocabulary.
competency_mappings.pcis: Diversity: This is nurtured when the learner appreciates others' diverse differences during learning and carries out activities harmoniously with them.

specific_learning_outcomes: a) Derive meaning of words from simple texts
b) Read simple texts to pick out vocabulary to show understanding
c) Show interest in reading simple texts
learning_activities: Select varied forms of greetings from simple texts, [Bonjour! Bonsoir!]
Read flashcards with words on greetings and taking leave and rearrange them to form simple sentences
Pick out vocabulary from a written text and use to communicate effectively in a social setup
Match the vocabulary of members of the family to the given images [C'est mon père]
Read captions with images to acquire vocabulary on friends, members of the nuclear and extended family
Find the meaning of the vocabulary in reading texts, collaboratively
key_inquiry_questions: Why do we read?
How do you identify words?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Self-efficacy: This is brought out as the learner clearly reads and identifies vocabulary from texts.
competency_mappings.values: Unity: This is nurtured as the learner works together to find the meaning of the vocabulary in reading texts.
competency_mappings.pcis: Social awareness skills: The learner uses the vocabulary acquired to communicate effectively in a social situation.

specific_learning_outcomes: a) List vocabulary from varied simple texts with the correct orthography
b) Construct simple texts using acquired vocabulary with the correct language patterns
c) Show enthusiasm in constructing sentences following the correct language structure
learning_activities: Underline vocabulary in texts about family and numbers
Fill in missing letters to form words on numbers, family members and greetings
Make letter flash cards and create words on family members in pairs
Use selected words to create short simple sentences
Rearrange jumbled-up words to create simple logical sentences
Match vocabulary on the nuclear family to the correct images from texts
Write simple texts to introduce members of one's family and friends, and displays it on the wall for others to read
key_inquiry_questions: What do you consider while writing simple texts?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Critical thinking and imagination: This is developed as learners create simple logical sentences.
competency_mappings.values: Responsibility: Is nurtured as learners accomplish tasks of creating flashcards with related vocabulary.
competency_mappings.pcis: Self-esteem: The learner develops self-esteem as they write about their family members and friends and display their work on the walls.

specific_learning_outcomes: a) Identify elements of grammar in simple texts
b) Construct simple sentences with correct language structures
c) Appreciate the importance of language structure in communication
learning_activities: Pick out personal pronouns and match them to the correct forms of verbs for oneself, family members and friends [je, il/elle...nous, s'appeler]
Fill in the gaps with the appropriate possessive adjectives to introduce members of the family and friends, [mon, ma, mes, ton, sa]
Rearrange jumbled-up words to make simple texts
Match personal pronouns to the correct form of the verbs
Source and watch audio-visual materials with countries and their nationalities jointly
Play conjugation games to practice reading different forms of verbs with peers (S'appeler, habiter, être, parler, avoir)
Seek guidance on how to conjugate verbs
key_inquiry_questions: How do you introduce yourself, family and friends?
Why do you need to observe grammar in your communication?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Digital literacy: This is fostered as the learner manipulates digital devices to source for audio-visual materials.
competency_mappings.values: Unity: This is enhanced as the learner appreciates collaboration in learning while playing conjugation games collaboratively.
competency_mappings.pcis: Self-awareness: This is brought out as the learners seek guidance in understanding language structures.

specific_learning_outcomes: a) Identify the main theme from an audio text
b) Extract relevant information from oral interactions
c) Show enthusiasm while listening to various audio texts on different topics
learning_activities: Listen to audio sounds to differentiate sounds /u/ as in ou, vous, nous and /y/ as in tu, du, vu
Listen collaboratively to an audio text and give a summary of location of different items in the home
Answer questions from an audio text on location of different items in the home (Où est la table? Elle est devant la porte)
Draw a layout of a home from information gotten from an audio text
Take turns with peers in giving directions on how to reach their homes, (D'abord, allez tout droit, puis, tournez à gauche.....La maison est en face de l'hôpital)
Identify effects of elements of weather on the environment from information obtained from an audio text
key_inquiry_questions: How can you locate different items in the home?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Creativity and imagination: This is developed as learners synthesize information and use imagination to create images of various occurrences.
competency_mappings.values: Unity: This is nurtured as the learner cooperates with peers in listening to audio texts to get summary of recorded information.
competency_mappings.pcis: Safety and security: This is brought about as the learner gains knowledge on importance of security and safety measures to take as they go to various destinations.

specific_learning_outcomes: a) Use correct language expressions to respond to questions on the given texts
b) Interpret information from written texts using the appropriate language
c) Appreciate the importance of reading texts
learning_activities: Read home layouts and associate places and rooms in the homes with their locations, jointly
Read and answer comprehension questions on the location of rooms and objects in a home, in pairs
Fill in blanks spaces in texts with expressions on location of places, rooms and objects at home
Observe and identify images with weather elements, with peers
Read weather charts and associate the weather elements to particular places (Kakamega-la pluie...)
Rearrange jumbled words to form expressions on weather, in pairs
Read aloud texts on locations of places and elements of weather
Appreciate elements of weather - j'aime le soleil...
key_inquiry_questions: Where are items and objects in your home located?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Critical thinking and problem solving: This is developed as the learner engages in reflective thinking and critical observation to make connections between places and their locations.
competency_mappings.values: Responsibility: This is nurtured as the learner displays hard work in reading texts and responding to questions.
competency_mappings.pcis: Self-awareness: This is brought about as the learner shows appreciation for weather elements in their environment.

specific_learning_outcomes: a) Classify nouns and prepositions in a guided writing assignment
b) Construct statements in guided writing exercises
c) Appreciate the use of prepositions and nouns in writing tasks
learning_activities: Locate different items in a house using prepositions (dans, entre, devant etc)
Label in writing the items which are normally found in the kitchen and stick them on the classroom board
Write sentences with vocabulary of items in a house and where they are normally placed
Fill in the blanks on an improvised weather report using nouns related to weather (la pluie, le vent, le soleil etc)
Reconstruct in writing jumbled up statements with nouns which are related to weather
key_inquiry_questions: Why is the arrangement of items important in a house?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Self-efficacy: The learner is guided to choose tasks which are eventually done when the grammatical task is completed.
competency_mappings.values: Responsibility: The learners performing the writing task on how various items are placed in a home gives them some subtle orientation on responsibility.
competency_mappings.pcis: Self-awareness: The learners display this tenet when they are able to locate and situate items within their space or locality.

specific_learning_outcomes: a) Identify prepositions and noun classes from the grammatical exercises
b) Apply the prepositions and nouns within grammatical context
c) Show an interest in two aspects of the grammatical structure
learning_activities: Present images, diagrams and physical objects to illustrate the prepositions (la tasse est sur la table, Mon lit est dans la chambre, etc)
Do matching games where they pair prepositions with the correct nouns using an improvised house plan
Fill in the blank exercises to place the appropriate prepositions
Present sentence scrambles which contain prepositions which should be reordered correctly
Complete the blanks with the correct preposition in a text (dans, sur, derrier, devant, dehors...)
Categorize nouns which deal with weather and display them on an improvised weather chart of a country, region or county
key_inquiry_questions: Why are prepositions important in the study of grammar?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Communication and collaboration: The learner is encouraged to use the nouns and prepositions in an organized order as these grammatical structures are studied in class.
competency_mappings.values: Integrity: The learner takes responsibility for learning actions as they perform the grammatical exercises and make amends or corrections when directed by the teachers.
competency_mappings.pcis: Self-awareness: The learner develops a sense of self-assurance as the use prepositions appropriately in a grammatical task.

specific_learning_outcomes: d) Respond to questions from an audio text to demonstrate understanding
e) Interpret information from audio text for effective communication
f) Show willingness to listen to a variety of audio texts
learning_activities: Associate the means of transport from audio stimuli to pictures on flashcards
Listen to audio materials with vocabulary on means of transport and answer comprehension questions (une voiture, un avion, un train, une moto, un vélo etc.)
Listen to an audio recording on safety measures to be observed when traveling and share the information with peers
Fill in travel documents with information given in an audio text
Use expressions from an audio text to describe how they travel (Je voyage en train, je prends un bus, Je vais à pied, j'utilise une moto pour aller à l'école)
Search online for audio visual materials on making reservations and explain the key points to their peers
Role play making a travel booking (Réserver une place; au guichet ou conversation téléphonique)
Listen to audio texts to practise words with sounds /ɛ/ and /e/
key_inquiry_questions: What means of transport do you use for travel?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Learning to learn: The learner shares what they have learnt from listening to an audio text on safety measures while traveling.
competency_mappings.values: Responsibility: This is brought out as the learner offers guidance to others by explaining key points to their peers on how to make reservations.
competency_mappings.pcis: Self awareness: This is enhanced through effective communication when giving details during making a reservation.

specific_learning_outcomes: a) Recognize key elements from simple texts and respond to questions
b) Use information from texts and answer questions
c) Exhibit enthusiasm for finding meanings of words from a variety of texts
learning_activities: Pick out vocabulary on means of transport and travel documents from simple texts and writeups, collaboratively, [une voiture, un vélo, une véhicule, un billet, un passeport, etc.]
Source for a variety of texts on internet and find more means of transport and expressions of travel, collectively
Read texts on means of transport and safety and discuss the information needed, with peers, [il faut attacher le ceinture, mettre la casquette, faire attention aux règles routière, etc.]
Look up for meanings of words from simple texts, with a partner and match them to the correct ones. [Je voyage à moto – je me déplace à moto]

Underline expressions on means of transport, travel and making reservations, from simple dialogues and texts, jointly, [Je vais à l'école à vélo, je voyage en bus, j'achète un billet, est-ce qu'il y a une siège... j'utilise un taxi pour]
key_inquiry_questions: How do you move around?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Self-efficacy: This is developed as learners clearly outline the procedures of making a reservation.
competency_mappings.values: Responsibility: Learners shows awareness of the safety measures to be taken while using certain means of transport.
competency_mappings.pcis: Safety and security: This is nurtured as learners talks about means of transport, they often use outlining safety measures they take in order to avoid accidents.

specific_learning_outcomes: a) List common words with orthography
b) Create simple sentences using language structures
c) Appreciate the role of guided writing in simple texts
learning_activities: Source from the internet and write the vocabulary on means of transport, [le bus, le train la moto, le taxi, l'avion, le bateau, le cheval...]
Rearrange letters to make words on vocabulary of means of transport, with peers
Write down simple texts on safety measures in transport [attacher, boucler la ceinture de sécurité, mettre le casque]
Using guided pictures, write simple sentences of likes and dislikes on means of transport
Fill crosswords and word puzzles on means of transport
key_inquiry_questions: Why do you choose means of transport?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Digital literacy: This is brought out as the learner confidently sources information from the internet.
competency_mappings.values: Unity: This is acquired when the learners work together harmoniously as they arrange letters to make words.
competency_mappings.pcis: Safety and security: This is nurtured as the learner uses the internet responsibly to access the required vocabulary.

specific_learning_outcomes: a) Identify the form of verb to use for a specific situation of communication
b) Select the language structure suitable for a given context of communication
c) Appreciate the importance of grammar for effective communication
learning_activities: Conjugate verbs for use in prescribed contexts of communication: voyager, aller, arriver, utiliser, prendre, acheter, réserver
Source for and play safe online interactive games on the conjugation of verbs related to transport
Choose the correct preposition to indicate the means of travel (Je vais à pied, je vais en bus)
Construct simple sentences related to means of transport (je prends un bus, je voyage en avion, j'utilise une moto)
Express obligation in observing safety measures when using means of transport: il faut + infinitif, il doit + infinitif – il faut attacher la ceinture de sécurité, il faut mettre le casque...)
Fill in personal details in travel documents observing the correct punctuation
key_inquiry_questions: How do you create correct sentences?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Critical thinking and problem solving: This is exhibited as learners use information provided to choose between the prepositions à and en in writing the means of travel one uses.
competency_mappings.values: Respect: The learner appreciates diverse opinions of others during discussions.
competency_mappings.pcis: Online safety: This is observed as learners use the internet responsibly as they source for and play safe online interactive games on conjugation of verbs.

specific_learning_outcomes: a) Exhibit comprehension and engagement in oral interactions
b) Use vocabulary and expressions to engage in oral presentations
c) Express enthusiasm in oral communication
learning_activities: Listen to short audiovisual clips on different foods and repeat, (les légumes, les fruits, le poisson, la viande, e.t.c)
Recite short simple poems to express likes and dislikes for certain foods
Use role play to express likes and dislikes for certain foods and drinks
Listen to audiovisual material to repeat the sounds, /u/sous, vous /y/ sur, vous
Sing songs jointly on names of different foods and drinks
Participate in simple dialogues using vocabulary and expressions on likes and dislikes for foods and drinks, (j'aime, j'aime beaucoup, je n'aime pas, je préfère, e.t.c)
key_inquiry_questions: When do you express preferences?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Self-efficacy: This is developed as learners skillfully manipulate audio-visual materials to listen to vocabulary on various types of food and drinks.
competency_mappings.values: Respect: This is nurtured as learners demonstrate patience in turn taking as they participate in dialogues on vocabulary.
competency_mappings.pcis: Self-awareness: Acquired when learners demonstrate appreciation of one another's preferences.

specific_learning_outcomes: a) Associate words in reading passages with ideas they represent
b) Draw on prior knowledge to recognize clues of information in a text
c) Show enthusiasm of identifying ideas and making summaries of comprehension texts
learning_activities: Read passages with vocabulary on foods and drinks and retell the main ideas
Differentiate healthy foods and drinks from unhealthy ones in different texts, advertisements and captions,...healthy foods(les légumes, les fruits...)...unhealthy food...(les frites, le chocolat...)
Make comparisons of the effects of consuming healthy and unhealthy food and drinks as they read texts with peers
Research collaboratively by reading texts on how to prepare healthy meals and drinks
Summarize written texts with peers on favourable foods and drinks that should be consumed to stay healthy.eg.(des oeufs, des lentilles...)
key_inquiry_questions: How can you use context clues to understand what you are reading?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Critical thinking and problem-solving: This is enhanced as the learner explores a complex challenge, takes time to understand it, carries out a research and explores different options to get a solution.
competency_mappings.values: Responsibility: This is nurtured as the learner shows diligence when engaging in researching to find solutions on healthy eating.
competency_mappings.pcis: Healthy practices for prevention of lifestyle diseases: The learner is sensitized on the importance of healthy living practices by choosing to eat healthy food.

specific_learning_outcomes: a) Identify expressions used to indicate foods and drinks
b) Create short simple texts translating their ideas into written
c) Appreciate the importance of the writing activity
learning_activities: Write sentences by matching expressions on foods and drinks to images/pictures
Fill in blank spaces to complete a simple story on given foods and drinks
Construct sentences on foods and drinks using given language structures
Summarize information in written texts on foods and drinks, collaboratively
Write simple sentences with il faut/il ne faut pas +verbe+ +activity/food to bring out the link between health and activities/foods
Write short dialogues on the subject: 'à table and à l'hôtel', jointly
Write simple family meal plans
key_inquiry_questions: What do you eat and drink?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Creativity and imagination: This is developed as the learner explores new ideas when writing family meal plans.
competency_mappings.values: Respect: This is developed as the learner displays positive regard to others as he/she constructs dialogues with others.
competency_mappings.pcis: Self-awareness: The learner accepts and appreciates him/herself and his/her peers as they carry out the assigned activities together.

specific_learning_outcomes: a) Select elements of grammar from simple texts
b) Write sentences with correct language structures
c) Appreciate the importance of grammar proper communication in interactions
learning_activities: Make a list of vocabulary on drinks, meals and legumes, from a variety of simple structured texts, in small groups, [Le jus, le vin, le poulet, la viande...les épinards]
Match names of food items to their corresponding images, in pairs
Construct simple sentences expressing what they want while expressing politeness, [je voudrais une tasse de thé, j'aimerais un verre de lait]
Practice using the correct adjectives of quantity in short sentences, as they match them to the images [un litre d'huile, un pincé du sel, une poignée de...]
Use correct forms of verbs to fill in the bank spaces in short sentences and texts, [boire, manger, goûter, prendre, déjeuner, avoir, aimer, preferer,etc.]

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Critical and problem solving: this is enhanced as learners search and explore different options as they seek solution to the matching expressions of quantity to the right images.
competency_mappings.values: Respect: this is developed as learners appreciate diverse opinions shared towards solution suggestions amongst themselves.
competency_mappings.pcis: Self-awareness: learners work together talking about healthy living lifestyles on meals they take.

strands.strand_name: 5.0 School and World of Work: School Routine

specific_learning_outcomes: a) Develop oral statements in interactive speaking
b) Construct dialogues in verbal communication
c) Appreciate feedback in verbal communication
learning_activities: Organize skits in pairs on the activities to be carried out in class and present orally in class
Present orally subjects being taught in class and link them to professions
Improvise in pairs a telephone game where inquiry is made asking about the date and activities for a school function
Source and study collaboratively audio-visual materials which contain event planning on the internet
Present orally what was witnessed from the audio-visual content on event, planning focusing on the date, time and the actual activities
Practice pronouncing /f/ and /v/ sounds in context (for example fille, mille, voiture, vrai)
key_inquiry_questions: Why confidence vital in interactive speaking?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Communication and collaboration: The learner speaks engagingly using the facts provided as activities which involve interactive speaking are done in a collaborative manner.
competency_mappings.values: Respect: The learner pays full attention when other are speaking without interrupting them as they wait to take their turn to communicate in learning activities which involve pair work.
competency_mappings.pcis: Self–esteem: The learner develops confidence to carry out oral presentations collaboratively as the personal skills and talents are honed with the constant practice.

specific_learning_outcomes: d) Identify related vocabulary from a written text
e) Use vocabulary acquired from read text to respond to questions and prompts
f) Display enthusiasm in reading texts to acquire vocabulary
learning_activities: Pick out vocabulary from a written text (les objets de classe - un crayon, une chaise, un cahier, une gomme...)
Match vocabulary to picture flashcards jointly
Read texts on les jours de la semaine, and use the vocabulary to ask and respond to questions (quel jour sommes-nous?) with peers
Pick out expressions of telling time from varied written texts to ask and tell time; quelle heure est-il? Il est...
Select school activities highlighted in varied written materials and tell when they take place
Choose vocabulary of school subjects in written texts and match to images on flash cards
Search online for school timetables and share the information with peers
Source for written texts on school routine and find related vocabulary jointly
key_inquiry_questions: Why do we learn vocabulary from written texts?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Communication and collaboration – This is developed as the learner participates actively in group activities to source for written materials and identify vocabulary from them.
competency_mappings.values: Unity - this is nurtured as the learner works harmoniously with other group members to accomplish assigned tasks.
competency_mappings.pcis: Self-esteem - This is exhibited as the learner confidently volunteers to share information sourced online on school timetables.

specific_learning_outcomes: a) Write short texts with correct orthography
b) Create simple texts with correct language patterns
c) Value the importance of writing using the correct language patterns
learning_activities: Make a list of objects in the classroom, jointly, [les affaires scolaires – le pupitre, le tableau interactif, la fenêtre, la porte, les cahiers, etc.]
Indicate time on different school activities, [La natation est à 5h00 du soir...]
Make a personal timetable indicating subjects and the time they are taught

Complete a short description of different school activities including moments of the day, days of the week and time [Lundi le matin, je nettoie la salle de classe, à huit heures, je commence mes cours...]
Write simple school routines on days of the week and subject, in small groups, [le lundi, j'ai l'histoire et la bilogie]
Fill in the blank spaces with the correct form of the articles [les articles définis et indéfinis: le, la,l',les, un, une,des]
key_inquiry_questions: How do you carry out your duties?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Critical thinking and problem solving: brought out as learners makes their personal routines in order to improve on time management.
competency_mappings.values: Unity: this is developed as learners work together making schedules.
competency_mappings.pcis: Self-awareness: This is brought out as the learners ask and tell date.

specific_learning_outcomes: d) Identify elements of grammar in simple texts
e) Construct simple sentences with right language structures
f) Value the importance of language structure in communication
learning_activities: Use days of the week and months of the year to ask and say the date in sentences [Quel jour sommes-nous? Nous sommes...]
Fill in the blank spaces with the appropriate indefinite and definite article in identification of the objects in the classroom
Rearrange jumbled up words to make simple texts on the school activities
Write simple texts about the school activities in the week
Express preference of the learning area by constructing simple sentences [j'aime le français, je préfère les mathématiques...]
key_inquiry_questions: Why is it essential to tell the date?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Creativity and imagination: This developed when the learner writes simple texts about the school activities in the week.
competency_mappings.values: Responsibility: This is enhanced as the learners take care of the items found in their classroom.
competency_mappings.pcis: Self-awareness: This is brought out as the learners ask and tell date.

specific_learning_outcomes: a) Respond to questions and prompts for effective interaction
b) Use vocabulary and expressions in oral interactions
c) Grow interest in participating actively in simple oral interactions
learning_activities: Listen to audio stimuli and speak on different types of shops [magasin, kiosque, supermarché, marchés,]
Listen to and sing songs with vocabulary on items sold at the market
Participate in role play as a shopkeeper and a customer in a shop to enhance oral skills
Recite simple poems to describe goods sold in the market on colour, sizes and price
Listen to and repeat words from audio stimuli on quantities and measure of different items from the market
Articulate words properly in oral interactions [/s/ son, serviette /v/ vous, veste]
key_inquiry_questions: Why do you choose a shopping place?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Communication and collaboration: This is brought out when the learner participates in role play as a shopkeeper and a customer.
competency_mappings.values: Responsibility: This is nurtured as the learners recite simple poems.
competency_mappings.pcis: Consumer awareness: This is brought as learners role play buying and selling of goods.

specific_learning_outcomes: a) Identify vocabulary from read texts
b) Use information from read simple texts
c) Exhibit confidence in reading through a variety of simple texts
learning_activities: Read simple texts to select vocabulary on shopping (une boucherie, une pharmacie, une boutique, couleurs e.t.c)
Record themselves while reading simple texts with vocabulary on shopping as peers assess them
Participate in card games to select words and expressions on shopping by reading, (beaucoup de, peu de, combien de, faire les achats, ça fait coûte combien? e.t.c)
Pick out expressions on shopping from simple written texts to construct sentences
Source and read sentences containing words on shopping from digital devices on shopping, in small groups
key_inquiry_questions: Why is it important to learn reading?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Self-efficacy: This is developed as learners confidently assess one another while reading simple texts.
competency_mappings.values: Responsibility: This is brought out as learners responsibly manipulate electronic devices to record their reading of simple texts.
competency_mappings.pcis: Safety and security: Developed when learners responsibly source for sentences on the internet.

specific_learning_outcomes: a) Identify different information and relate it to different contexts
b) Change visual representation of ideas to text
c) Show enthusiasm in entrepreneurship and wise spending
learning_activities: Write down lists of different items found in different shops..(des vêtements, des chaussures, des meubles...)
Write collaboratively short texts on activities done at shopping centres using vocabulary of buying and selling..(acheter, vendre, coûter...,
Write dialogues between sellers and a buyers in shops; include prices, modes of payment, quantities, weights and measurements of goods... (Je voudrais un kilo de sucre, une bouteille de vin...)
Create a story from an image on a visit to a shopping centre describing shops...(En ville il y des magasins, des supermarchés...)
Compare in writing shopping experiences in different parts of the world..(En Europe on fait des achats en ligne.)
key_inquiry_questions: Why is it important to have writing skills?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Creativity and imagination: This is enhanced when the learner comes up with new and innovative ways of doing tasks as they create texts from images.
competency_mappings.values: Integrity: This is nurtured as the learner displays honesty when giving the right measurement, quantities and prices of goods in a shopping experience.
competency_mappings.pcis: Financial literacy: The learner is sensitized on entrepreneurship and wise spending of money.

specific_learning_outcomes: a) Construct sentences with correct language structures
b) Describe items using correct language patterns
c) Appreciate the role of grammatical elements in effective communication
learning_activities: Make kind requests by use of the polite form of the verb 'vouloir' in pairs
Associate expressions of quantity with given nouns (un kilo de viande...)
Fill in the open spaces with the correct adjectives describing goods and cloths (couleur, taille, nombres ordinaux...)
Construct sentences using given expressions of shopping (faire les achats/les courses/les provisions...)

Construct mini dialogues using demonstrative adjectives (ce, cette...), interrogative adjectives, relative pronouns (quel, quelle...lequel, laquelle...) and demonstrative pronouns (celui, celle-ci...)
Practice conjugation of verbs matching personal pronouns to the correct form of the verbs with peers (j'achète..., j'essaie..., il coûte...)
Practice role plays on the topics: 'sur le marché' and 'dans un magasin' to practice the language structures used when buying and selling
Appreciate him/herself as he/she carries out learning tasks
key_inquiry_questions: What description can you give to the items that you buy from shops and markets in terms of size, colour, weight..?

competency_mappings.core_competencies: Learning to learn: This is developed as the learner collaboratively practices role playing on buying and selling.
competency_mappings.values: Love: This is nurtured as the learner uses kind language in soliciting for services in buying and selling scenarios.
competency_mappings.pcis: Self-esteem: This is brought about as the learner accepts and appreciates him/herself as he/she carries out learning tasks.

indicators: Ability to use vocabulary and expressions in oral interactions
Ability to speak the language with correct pronunciation, intonation, rhythm and articulation in oral expression
Ability to respond to questions and prompts in oral interactions
Ability to extract and interpret information from oral interactions
Ability to display willingness to participate in oral interactions
Ability to derive meaning of vocabulary and expressions from simple texts
Ability to respond correctly to questions on selected written texts
Ability to display willingness to participate in reading different type of texts
